CIE Scotopic Luminous Efficiency Function

Source: R/data.R
CIE_scotopic.Rd

The CIE scotopic luminous efficiency function V'(lambda) for night vision, from CIE 018:2019 Table 2. Tabulated at 1 nm intervals from 380 nm to 780 nm, with its peak at 507 nm. Used by scotopic_lux.

Usage

CIE_scotopic

Format

A data frame with 401 rows and 2 columns:

lambda

Wavelength in standard air, in nm (380-780, step 1).

W

V'(lambda), dimensionless sensitivity from 0 to 1.

Source

International Commission on Illumination (CIE), CIE spectral luminous efficiency for scotopic vision, DOI: doi:10.25039/CIE.DS.gr6w4b5g , licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

Details

Generated by data-raw/build_cie_efficiency_data.R from the checksum-pinned CIE CSV and companion metadata. Source URLs, DOI, checksums, retrieval date, standard, and license are stored as data-frame attributes under "luxR.provenance".
